thread:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up: owners and deadlines for vendor/dependency mitigations (cloud auth spikes + model-registry flakiness).

maya: TL; two quick fixes this week, hardening + drill over next 3 sprints. Will add action rows when owners confirmed.

alex: I can own cloud fallback automation (cross-region routing + retry windows). Prototype + dry-run by Fri.

jordan: I'll take registry auth TTL rotation and clearer error taxonomy + synthetic checks. PR by next Tue.

anika: Alerts and runbook updates are mine; will add pager thresholds and short playbook. Merge alerts by Thu.

liam: I'll coordinate a failover drill (auth+registry+routing). Propose Wed week-after-next.

maya: Proposed actions: A1 cloud fallback (alex) - dry-run Fri, merge Tue; A2 registry auth TTL (jordan) - PR Tue, canary Thu; A3 alerts+runbook (anika) - Thu; A4 failover drill (liam) - plan Mon, drill Weds; A5 short-term tweak (maya) - increase retry backoff during spikes.

maya: Observed patterns: auth bursts around 20:45 UTC (provider throttles), registry 5xxs during scaler windows. Instrument: auth 429/5xx per min, registry queue length & smoothed 5xx, fallback success-rate.

alex: Plan for A1: shim to route to secondary region after 3 auth failures in 30s + circuit-breaker. Prefer retry-first?

anika: Recommend 3 retries with small backoff, then fallback. Alert if fallback rate >1% over 5m.

jordan: Will add 15s canary to registry and a logging field for upstream provider IDs to help correlation.

liam: Drill will simulate auth-region outage; ensure model-serving uses pinned cache and console shows degraded-but-operational. Include rollback.

maya: I'll create tracker rows A1..A5 and set priorities. If auth spikes >2 in 2 weeks, escalate vendor SLA review.

deploy-bot: IncidentBot: runbook "vendor-fallbacks" updated by anika - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vendor-fallbacks

anika: Can we add a 15m weekly "vendor-surge" sync in incidents for 6 weeks? Quick status and pattern updates.

maya: Yes, Wednesdays 09:30 PT for 6 weeks. I'll schedule.

liam: Drafting drill checklist, will post by Mon.

maya: Closing loop: owners alex(A1), jordan(A2), anika(A3), liam(A4), maya(A5). Timelines in tracker.

maya: End thread - will paste tracker link when created.
